name: technology-profiles
description: Add the composable Technology Profile system and optionally install one or more selected profiles.
adds: selected Technology Profile documents and skills
notes: Requires --ai-surface so common and profile-specific skills are installed consistently.
Profiles can be added after WORK/0.1 technology selection.
Customized profile documents are preserved as SKIP(KEEP).
A customized legacy PLATFORM_GUIDELINE.md is moved to LEGACY_PLATFORM_GUIDELINE.md for manual review.
Apply stops when a legacy guideline cannot be mapped safely.
This feature does not write to another repository or publish knowledge feedback.
